zh.name: {NICKNAME}
zh.desc: 登上星穹列车的{F#少女}{M#少年}。\n为了消除星核带来的危机，选择与星穹列车同行。

1.name: 相信光的时间
1.desc: 施放战技后，下一次终结技使我方目标获得的【<u>好活当赏</u>】提高<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点，该效果最多叠加<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层。

10000029.name: 好活当赏
10000029.desc: 使参演阿哈时刻的角色获得【好活当赏】状态，并将本次阿哈时刻的笑点计入该状态，持续2回合。【好活当赏】状态产生的技能效果和欢愉伤害以【好活当赏】计入的笑点数计算。\n多个【好活当赏】计入的笑点数合并计算。\n各个【好活当赏】的持续时间各自独立计算。

2.name: 名场面酝酿中……
2.desc: 终结技额外使指定我方单体的欢愉度提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>，持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合。

3.name: 来吧，镜头的焦点
3.desc: 战技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；欢愉技等级+1，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级。

4.name: 拯救世界，无需理由
4.desc: 施放欢愉技时，使敌方目标受到的伤害提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>，持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合。

5.name: 爱与勇气，永不过时
5.desc: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过<unbreak>10</unbreak>级；欢愉技等级+1，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级。

6.name: 银河传奇，登场！
6.desc: 施放欢愉技时，使自身暴击伤害提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>，持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合。

800901.name: 此即应援
800901.desc: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于开拓者<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
800901.simple_desc: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害。

800902.name: 风暴甚是喧嚣
800902.desc: 对敌方全体造成等同于开拓者<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点【<u>好活当赏</u>】。
800902.simple_desc: 对敌方全体造成少量雷属性伤害，获得【<u>好活当赏</u>】。

10000029.name: 好活当赏
10000029.desc: 使参演阿哈时刻的角色获得【好活当赏】状态，并将本次阿哈时刻的笑点计入该状态，持续2回合。【好活当赏】状态产生的技能效果和欢愉伤害以【好活当赏】计入的笑点数计算。\n多个【好活当赏】计入的笑点数合并计算。\n各个【好活当赏】的持续时间各自独立计算。

800903.name: 放心飞，开拓永相随！
800903.desc: 获得<unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak>个<u>笑点</u>，使指定我方单体暴击伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合，并解除该目标的<u>控制类负面状态</u>。\n若目标拥有欢愉技，目标额外获得<unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>点【<u>好活当赏</u>】，并使其立即施放1次固定计入<unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak><u>笑点</u>的欢愉技，若欢愉技施放前敌方目标被消灭则对新入场的敌方目标发动欢愉技。\n若目标不拥有欢愉技，使其<u>行动提前</u><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>。
800903.simple_desc: 获得<u>笑点</u>，使指定我方单体暴击伤害提高，并解除该目标的<u>控制类负面状态</u>。若目标拥有欢愉技，<color=#f29e38ff>目标额外获得【<u>好活当赏</u>】</color>，并使其<color=#f29e38ff>立即施放欢愉技</color>，否则使其<u>行动提前</u>。

10000001.name: 行动提前
10000001.desc: 使目标在下次行动前的等待间隔缩短。

10000011.name: 控制类负面状态
10000011.desc: 冻结，纠缠，禁锢，支配，怒噪，强烈震荡，异梦，缠禁，恐惧，行动锁定，幸福傀儡，怨火灼身，麻痹。

10000027.name: 笑点
10000027.desc: 笑点为全队共享。造成欢愉伤害时，计入的笑点越多，欢愉伤害越高。

10000029.name: 好活当赏
10000029.desc: 使参演阿哈时刻的角色获得【好活当赏】状态，并将本次阿哈时刻的笑点计入该状态，持续2回合。【好活当赏】状态产生的技能效果和欢愉伤害以【好活当赏】计入的笑点数计算。\n多个【好活当赏】计入的笑点数合并计算。\n各个【好活当赏】的持续时间各自独立计算。

800904.name: 英雄一笑，生死难料
800904.desc: 施放攻击后，固定恢复<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点能量并获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>个<u>笑点</u>。\n开拓者持有【<u>好活当赏</u>】时，战技对敌方全体额外造成<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>的雷属性<u>欢愉伤害</u>，此伤害使用我方最高的【<u>好活当赏</u>】数值计算。
800904.simple_desc: 施放攻击后恢复能量并获得<u>笑点</u>。\n开拓者持有【<u>好活当赏</u>】时，战技对敌方全体额外造成少量雷属性<u>欢愉伤害</u>。

10000027.name: 笑点
10000027.desc: 笑点为全队共享。造成欢愉伤害时，计入的笑点越多，欢愉伤害越高。

10000028.name: 欢愉伤害
10000028.desc: 计入的笑点越多，欢愉度、角色等级越高，则造成的欢愉伤害越高。\n欢愉伤害不受伤害提高类效果所影响。

10000029.name: 好活当赏
10000029.desc: 使参演阿哈时刻的角色获得【好活当赏】状态，并将本次阿哈时刻的笑点计入该状态，持续2回合。【好活当赏】状态产生的技能效果和欢愉伤害以【好活当赏】计入的笑点数计算。\n多个【好活当赏】计入的笑点数合并计算。\n各个【好活当赏】的持续时间各自独立计算。

800906.name: 攻击
800906.desc: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。
800906.simple_desc: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

800907.name: 燃起来了！
800907.desc:
使用秘技后随机获得以下1种效果：
小概率获得【开怀大笑】：欢愉度提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。
大概率获得【忍俊不禁】：欢愉度提高<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>。
下一次战斗开始时，使我方全体提高对应数值的欢愉度，持续<unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>回合。
800907.simple_desc: 使用秘技后，下一次进入战斗时使我方<color=#f29e38ff>全体欢愉度提高</color>。

800920.name: 我说欢愉，你耳朵聋吗？
800920.desc: 造成<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>次伤害，每次对敌方随机单体造成<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>的雷属性<u>欢愉伤害</u>。最后造成<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>的雷属性<u>欢愉伤害</u>，由敌方全体均分。
800920.simple_desc: 造成多次伤害，每次对敌方随机单体造成少量雷属性<u>欢愉伤害</u>，最后造成由敌方全体均分的雷属性<u>欢愉伤害</u>。

10000028.name: 欢愉伤害
10000028.desc: 计入的笑点越多，欢愉度、角色等级越高，则造成的欢愉伤害越高。\n欢愉伤害不受伤害提高类效果所影响。

800929.name: 欢愉万相★主角光环
800929.desc: 当<color=#cb2f2f><u>「欢愉」命途升格</u></color>时，终结技的暴击伤害提高效果额外提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，并对我方全体生效。终结技触发星神★阿哈的欢愉技前，额外触发一次开拓者的欢愉技，本次欢愉技的伤害倍率提高原倍率的<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，并基于我方角色持有的【<u>绝活共赏</u>】最高值进行计算。随后触发的星神★阿哈欢愉技，其<u>真实伤害</u>改为按上述开拓者欢愉技造成伤害的<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>计算，由敌方全体均分。
800929.simple_desc: 当<color=#cb2f2f><u>「欢愉」命途升格</u></color>时，终结技提供的暴击伤害提高效果额外提高，并对我方全体生效。终结技触发星神★阿哈的欢愉技前，额外触发一次开拓者的欢愉技，本次欢愉技的伤害倍率提高，并基于我方角色持有的【<u>绝活共赏</u>】最高值进行计算。随后触发的星神★阿哈欢愉技，其<u>真实伤害</u>改为基于上述开拓者欢愉技造成的伤害计算，由敌方全体均分。

10000017.name: 真实伤害
10000017.desc: 不受任何效果所影响的无属性伤害，本次伤害不视为造成了1次攻击。

10015111.name: 「欢愉」命途升格
10015111.desc: 星神★阿哈持有【欢愉万相】状态时，【笑点】与【好活当赏】强化为【爽点】和【绝活共赏】，我方「欢愉」命途角色将激活【固有行迹】效果。

10015113.name: 绝活共赏
10015113.desc: 获得【绝活共赏】状态时视为获得【好活当赏】状态，【绝活共赏】数值将影响我方「欢愉」命途角色的【固有行迹】效果。

1.point_desc: 若开拓者的攻击力高于<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点，每超过<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点攻击力可使自身欢愉度提高<unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak>，最多提高<unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak>。
自身暴击率提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。施放终结技后，为我方恢复<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>个战技点。
我方目标施放欢愉技后，开拓者下一次施放战技时额外获得<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点【<u>好活当赏</u>】。

10000029.name: 好活当赏
10000029.desc: 使参演阿哈时刻的角色获得【好活当赏】状态，并将本次阿哈时刻的笑点计入该状态，持续2回合。【好活当赏】状态产生的技能效果和欢愉伤害以【好活当赏】计入的笑点数计算。\n多个【好活当赏】计入的笑点数合并计算。\n各个【好活当赏】的持续时间各自独立计算。

en.name: {NICKNAME}
en.desc: A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.\n{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

1.name: Believe In the Light
1.desc: After using Skill, the next Ultimate increases the amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" gained by ally targets by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

2.name: History in the Making...
2.desc: Ultimate additionally increases the Elation of one designated ally by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

3.name: Into the Spotlight
3.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

4.name: Save the World. Just Because.
4.desc: When using Elation Skill, increases the DMG taken by enemy targets by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

5.name: Love & Courage: Always in Style
5.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

6.name: The Cosmic Legend Cometh!
6.desc: When using Elation Skill, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turns.

800901.name: Make Some Noise
800901.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
800901.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

800902.name: Let the Storm Rage On
800902.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>."
800902.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies and gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>."

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

800903.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
800903.desc: Gains <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on them.\nIf the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s). If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target.\nIf the target does not have Elation Skill, their <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
800903.simple_desc: Gains <u>Punchline</u>. Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally, and dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on that target. If the target has Elation Skill, the <color=#f29e38ff>target additionally gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>"</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>immediately uses their Elation Skill</color>. Otherwise, their <u>action advances</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze, Paralysis.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

800904.name: That Smile Hits Different
800904.desc: After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s).\nWhen the Trailblazer holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," their Skill additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "<u>Certified Banger</u>" value among all allies.
800904.simple_desc: After using an attack, regenerates Energy and gains <u>Punchline</u>.\nWhen the Trailblazer holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," their Skill additionally deals minor Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

800906.name: Attack
800906.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
800906.simple_desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

800907.name: We Are So Back!
800907.desc:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
800907.simple_desc: After using Technique, <color=#f29e38ff>increases all allies' Elation</color> when entering the next battle.

800920.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
800920.desc: Deals <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> instances of DMG, with each instance dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. At last, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u>, which is split evenly among all enemies.
800920.simple_desc: Deals multiple instances of DMG, with each instance dealing minor Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. At last, deals Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> that is split evenly among all enemies.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

800929.name: Faces of Elation ★ Plot Armor
800929.desc: When the <color=#cb2f2f><u>Path of Elation ascends</u></color>, the Ultimate's CRIT DMG boost effect additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and takes effect on all allies. Before the Ultimate triggers Aeon ★ Aha's Elation Skill, it additionally triggers the Trailblazer's Elation Skill. This Elation Skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier, and is calculated based on the highest value of "<u>Party Trick</u>" held by an ally character. Then, Aeon ★ Aha's Elation Skill is triggered, with its <u>True DMG</u> changed to be calculated based on <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of DMG dealt by the aforementioned Trailblazer's Elation Skill, and is distributed equally among all enemies.
800929.simple_desc: When the <color=#cb2f2f><u>Path of Elation ascends</u></color>, the CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Ultimate additionally increases and takes effect on all allies. Before the Ultimate triggers Aeon ★ Aha's Elation Skill, it additionally triggers the Trailblazer's Elation Skill. This Elation Skill's DMG multiplier increases, and is calculated based on the highest value of "<u>Party Trick</u>" held by an ally character. Then, Aeon ★ Aha's Elation Skill is triggered, with its <u>True DMG</u> changed to be calculated based on the DMG dealt by the aforementioned Trailblazer's Elation Skill, and is distributed equally among all enemies.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as launching 1 attack.

10015111.name: Path of Elation Ascension
10015111.desc: When Aeon ★ Aha has the "Faces of Elation" state, "Punchline" and "Certified Banger" are enhanced to "Bliss" and "Party Trick," and ally characters on the Path of Elation will activate their "Innate Trace" effects.

10015113.name: Party Trick
10015113.desc: When gaining the "Party Trick" state, it is considered the same as gaining the "Certified Banger" state. The "Party Trick" will affect the "Innate Trace" effects of ally Elation characters.

1.point_desc: For every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Trailblazer's ATK that exceeds <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, increases this unit's Elation stat by <unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak>, up to a maximum increase of <unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak>.
Increases this unit's CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After using Ultimate, recovers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for the team.
After an ally target uses Elation Skill, Trailblazer additionally gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" the next time they use their Skill.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.
